core.title: Fancy 10 Inch Push Plate, Acorn RMSBP

text.description_html:
Acorn RMSBP, Fancy 10" Iron Push Plate

The Fancy 10" Push Plate features a decorative design. This push plate will add a medieval touch to any door. The black iron finish has a lifetime no-rust warranty. It is packaged complete with all mounting hardware for easy installation. A breath of fresh air from standard rectangular push plates, it is a beautiful way to protect your doors.

Specifications of the Acorn RMSBP Fancy 10" Push Plate:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Plate Height 10"
  • Plate Width: 3-3/8"
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty

Sold individually. Package includes 1 push plate and hardware for a surface mounted application.
